task: Analyze the HEEW mini dataset and reproduce core evidence for a multi-source hierarchical hourly energy-weather benchmark dataset.
explicit_methodological_commitments: Use raw hourly energy sensor measurements for 10 buildings plus CN01 and Total aggregate files for 2014.
Use meteorological observations in Total_weather.csv and align them hourly to energy records.
Produce data cleaning algorithms/diagnostics for missingness, duplicates, temporal regularity, non-physical values, and robust outliers.
Perform correlation analysis between electricity, heat, cooling, PV generation, GHG emissions, and weather attributes.
Verify hierarchical aggregation consistency: sum of BN001-BN010 versus CN01 and Total, and CN01 versus Total.
Generate publication-quality PNG figures and a report with methodology, results, validation/comparison plots, discussion, and limitations.
fallbacks_or_limitations: Only the provided mini dataset is available locally: year 2014, 10 buildings, CN01, Total, and one Total weather file, not the full 2014-2022 147-building HEEW release.
PDF parser failed on related_work PDFs; related-work extraction is limited to PDF metadata/strings and task description.
